description: Synthetic conversation library for Genesys Cloud WEM demos and testing.

scenarios.name: Cancellation
scenarios.description: Retention conversations that end in cancellation for different reasons.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Hi, I'd like to cancel my policy.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Can I ask what has prompted the cancellation?

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I've found the same cover online for £14 less a month.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I understand. Let me check what options I can offer on your current policy.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can reduce the monthly price, but it would still be £8 more than the online quote you've found.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Yes, I think I'll go with the cheaper option.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Understood. I'll process the cancellation for you and confirm the effective date before we finish.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: That's fine. Thank you.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I want to cancel. I've had enough of this.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'm sorry you've had that experience. Can you tell me what has gone wrong?

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I've called three times about the same issue and nobody has fixed it.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can see why that would be frustrating. Let me look at the previous contacts.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I've already explained it three times.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You're right, and I don't want to make you repeat yourself. I can see the issue from the notes.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: At this point I just want to leave.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I understand. I'll process the cancellation and make sure the final details are clear.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Okay.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I'd like to cancel my service, please.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Of course. Can I ask whether there is anything we could change that would make you want to keep it?

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: No, I've moved house and I don't need the service anymore.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: That makes sense. Let me check the end date and any final balance for you.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Sure.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Everything is clear. I can arrange the cancellation today.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Perfect. Thanks for making that easy.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You're welcome. I'll send confirmation of the cancellation.

scenarios.name: Retention
scenarios.description: Customers considering leaving where the agent successfully changes the outcome.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: My price has gone up again. I'm thinking of leaving.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can help with that. Let me review your current cover and the available options.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I've been with you for years and it keeps getting more expensive.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I appreciate that. I can see your loyalty with us, and there is a lower-cost option that keeps the core cover.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: How much lower?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: It would reduce the monthly price by £11.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Okay, I'd be happy with that.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'll make that change now and send you the updated confirmation.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Another provider is offering me the same thing for less.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thanks for letting me know. What matters most to you in comparing the two offers?

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Mostly price, but I don't want to lose the cover I already have.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can review the exact cover with you so we are comparing like for like.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: That would be useful.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: There are a couple of differences in the competitor quote that aren't obvious from the headline price.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: In that case I think I'll stay.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Great. I'll leave your existing cover unchanged and note that you've decided to continue.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: After what happened last week, I don't see why I should stay.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I understand. Let me look at what happened and see what I can do to put it right.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I was promised a callback and nobody called.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You're right, the callback wasn't completed. I'm sorry.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: So why should I trust you now?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can take ownership today. I'll resolve the outstanding issue during this contact and arrange a written confirmation.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: If you can actually fix it, I'll stay.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'll do that now and make sure the case is closed correctly.

scenarios.name: Billing Complaint
scenarios.description: Billing issues with different levels of frustration and resolution.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I've been charged twice this month.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'm sorry about that. I'll check the two transactions for you.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: The amounts are exactly the same.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can see the duplicate charge. I'll arrange the refund for the second payment.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: How long will that take?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: The refund should reach your account within five working days.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Okay, thanks.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Why has my payment increased? Nobody told me about this.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'll check the account and explain exactly what changed.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Because it is a lot more than last month.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can see that a promotional discount ended this month. The underlying price hasn't changed.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I didn't realise the discount was ending.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I understand. I can outline the available plans and what each would cost going forward.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Please do.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: The standard plan is the lowest ongoing price and keeps the cover you currently use.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I can't afford this payment right now. I'm really worried.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'm sorry this is causing you stress. Let's look at what options are available before we do anything else.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I just need some time to catch up.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: We can look at a payment arrangement and I can explain the impact before you agree to anything.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Yes, please.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'll set out the options and make sure you have confirmation of what we've agreed.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Thank you. That helps.

scenarios.name: Technical Support
scenarios.description: Support interactions with resolution quality differences.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: This is the fourth time I've contacted you about the same problem.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'm sorry you've had to contact us repeatedly. I'll take ownership of it now.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: The service keeps dropping every evening.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'll check the previous troubleshooting steps so we don't repeat them.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Good, because I've already reset everything.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can see that. The next step needs specialist support, so I'll escalate it with the details already captured.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Okay, as long as I don't have to start again.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You won't. I'll include the history and the tests you've already completed.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: My connection is working but I can't get the app to load.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Let's check a couple of things. Are you able to sign in on the website?

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Yes, the website works.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: In that case the quickest fix is to refresh the app session. I'll talk you through it.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I've done that now.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Great. Please try opening the app again.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: It's working now.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Excellent. I'll record that the issue was resolved during this contact.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: The app doesn't work and I've already tried restarting it.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Try clearing the cache.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I already did that.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Okay. Uninstall it and reinstall it.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Will that actually fix it?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: It should.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Fine.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Let me know if it doesn't.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: It is working now.

scenarios.name: Sales / Upsell
scenarios.description: Sales opportunities detected in normal service conversations.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I've been happy with the service. Do you offer home cover as well?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Yes, we do. I can explain the main options and check what would suit your current cover.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I'm mostly interested in contents cover.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: We have a contents option that can be added alongside your existing service.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: What would that cost?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Based on your current details, the additional premium would be £9.50 a month.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: That sounds reasonable. Let's add it.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Absolutely. I'll arrange that and confirm the updated cover.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: My colleague mentioned you do business cover too.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: We do. Are you looking for cover for a new business or an existing one?

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: An existing business. We're reviewing suppliers this month.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: That sounds like a good time to compare options. I can capture a few details so the right specialist can follow up.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Sure.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: What type of business are you running and roughly how many employees do you have?

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: A small consultancy with 18 employees.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thanks. I'll pass that to our business team with your enquiry so they can contact you.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I just need help with my current policy today.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Of course. I'll focus on that first. There is another product that may also be relevant, but we can leave that aside unless you'd like information.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: No thanks, not at the moment.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: No problem. Let's get your current issue sorted.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Thank you.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You're welcome. Your current policy has been updated as requested.

scenarios.name: Complaint / Escalation
scenarios.description: Interactions where dissatisfaction leads to escalation, resolution or recovery.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I want to speak to a supervisor. This is unacceptable.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can help with that. Before I transfer you, I'll make sure the supervisor has the details so you don't need to repeat everything.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I've been promised three different things.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can see the previous commitments and I'll include them in the escalation notes.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Okay, but I don't want another explanation.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Understood. I'll keep the handoff concise and include the outstanding actions.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Fine.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: The supervisor is now joining and has the case history.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: The service I've received has been terrible.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'm sorry. I want to understand exactly what has happened and see what I can do to fix it.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Nobody seems to know what is happening with my request.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'll take ownership of the request during this contact and give you a clear next step.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Okay, what happens now?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I've confirmed the request is pending one document. I can tell you exactly what is needed and where to send it.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: That's the first clear answer I've had.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'm glad we could clarify it. I'll also record the previous confusion so the next step is not delayed.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: If this isn't fixed today, I'll take my business somewhere else.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I understand the urgency. Let me confirm exactly what remains unresolved.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I was charged for something I never agreed to.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'll investigate the charge and check the original agreement before I give you an answer.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: That's all I want. A proper answer.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can see the charge was applied incorrectly and needs review by our billing team.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: So what happens now?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'm escalating it today and recording that you need a clear outcome before you decide whether to continue with us.

scenarios.name: Compliance / Risk
scenarios.description: Conversations designed to create searchable compliance and coaching signals.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I need you to change the address on my account.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can help with that. I'll need to complete the standard security checks first.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Why do I need to answer all these questions?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: They help protect your account. I know it adds a little time, but I need to complete them before making the change.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Okay.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thanks. The verification is complete and I can now update the address.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Fine.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Can you guarantee this will be refunded today?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Yes, absolutely, it will be back in your account today.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: So I don't need to do anything else?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: No, you can consider it guaranteed.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Okay, thank you.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You're welcome.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Can you give me the full card details you have saved?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can confirm the payment method on file, but I can't provide the full card details.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Even to me?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can only display the last four digits for security reasons.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Okay, what are they?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: The saved payment method ends in 4821.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: That's fine.

scenarios.name: Mixed Sentiment
scenarios.description: Designed to demonstrate sentiment movement from negative to positive within one interaction.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I've been trying to sort this out all morning and I'm getting nowhere.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'm sorry you've spent so much time on it. I'll take ownership and work through it with you.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I just want someone to actually solve it.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Understood. I've found the issue and I can correct it from here.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Really?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Yes. I've completed the change and the account now shows the correct status.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I've just refreshed it and I can see it now.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Great. I'll document the fix so you don't have to contact us again about the same issue.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Thank you, I appreciate that.

conversations.name: Mostly positive with one friction point

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Everything has been fine apart from one issue with my latest bill.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'm glad the rest has been going well. Let's look at the billing issue.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: The date on it doesn't look right.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You're right, that date is incorrect on the statement. I'll correct it.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Perfect, thanks.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You're welcome. I'll send the corrected statement now.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Thanks for helping me with the first part. I just need one more thing changed.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Absolutely. Tell me what you need changed.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I need the name corrected on the account.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can do that, but it needs to go through our specialist team.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Can you just change it?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I'm afraid I can't because of the account rules.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: So now I have to contact another team for one simple change?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Yes, and I'm sorry for the extra step. I can transfer you with the details so you don't need to start again.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Fine.
